dogecoin.text: If Elon Musk will not become Batman, then he owes us a trip to Mars or making us billionaires with Dogecoin.

Her:  Why are you looking at 3-D metal printers?

Me:  Dogecoin, above $.40 again.

Her:  No, you need to put that in one of your TOD Mutual Funds from T. Rowe Price or American, especially at your age.

Me:  That last part hurt some.

Her:  Someone must speak truth to power.
